name: SEGUIMIENTO SALIENTE - Cadencia 24h (CW + Rances Car)
description: Seguimiento saliente automático cada 15 min para Carwarriors y Rances Car dentro de la ventana de 24h de Meta: Intento 1 (1h), Intento 2 (5h, $0 down) e Intento 3 (20h, push-away close).

parameters.queryParameters: ={{ (() => { const dt = $now.setZone('America/New_York'); const isMorningBatch = (dt.weekday === 7 && dt.hour === 10 && dt.minute < 15) || (dt.weekday !== 7 && dt.hour === 9 && dt.minute < 15); const lookbackMins = isMorningBatch ? 750 : 75; return [ $now.minus({minutes: lookbackMins}).toISO(), $now.minus({minutes: 60}).toISO(), $now.minus({minutes: 315}).toISO(), $now.minus({minutes: 300}).toISO(), $now.minus({minutes: 1215}).toISO(), $now.minus({minutes: 1200}).toISO() ]; })() }}

parameters.jsonOutput: ={{ (() => { const cand = $('Buscar Leads Silenciosos').item.json; const prev = $json || {}; const lastMs = cand.last_interaction ? new Date(cand.last_interaction).getTime() : 0; const diffMins = lastMs ? (Date.now() - lastMs) / 60000 : 0; let targetIntento = 1; let yaEnviado = false; const mismoSilencio = prev.last_interaction_relevante && prev.last_interaction_relevante === cand.last_interaction; if (!mismoSilencio) { targetIntento = 1; yaEnviado = false; } else { const previoIntento = prev.intento || 1; if (previoIntento === 1) { if (diffMins >= 180) { targetIntento = 2; yaEnviado = false; } else { yaEnviado = true; } } else if (previoIntento === 2) { if (diffMins >= 600) { targetIntento = 3; yaEnviado = false; } else { yaEnviado = true; } } else { yaEnviado = true; } } return { contactId: cand.contactId, locationId: cand.locationId, dealer: cand.dealer, last_interaction: cand.last_interaction, interes_vehiculo: cand.interes_vehiculo || '', language: cand.language || 'es', input_channel: cand.input_channel || '', intento: targetIntento, yaEnviado }; })() }}

conditions.leftValue: ={{ (() => { const dt = $now.setZone('America/New_York'); const day = dt.weekday; const mins = dt.hour * 60 + dt.minute; let openMins = 9 * 60; let closeMins = 20 * 60 + 30; if (day === 6) { closeMins = 19 * 60; } else if (day === 7) { openMins = 10 * 60; closeMins = 16 * 60 + 30; } return mins >= openMins && mins < closeMins; })() }}
